name: trackmate-pwa
description: TrackMate PWA prototype with consent-based WebRTC monitoring and backend heartbeat push alerts.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check api/health.js && node --check api/heartbeat.js && node --check api/check-heartbeats.js && node --check api/push/public-key.js && node --check api/push/subscribe.js && node --check api/_lib/supabase.js
scripts.health: node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + (process.env.PORT || 8765) + '/api/health').then(async r => { console.log(r.status, await r.text()); process.exit(r.ok ? 0 : 1); }).catch(err => { console.error(err.message); process.exit(1); })"
